title: refactor(ts): migrate geo components
body:
**Summary**

migrates the geosearch components, the remaining last ones not yet in TS

**Result**

* no more usage of prop-types 🤔
* wrapped a component in a fragment because of https://github.com/DefinitelyTyped/DefinitelyTyped/issues/18912 / https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/issues/21699
